subject: Running cron jobsof R scripts together with Shiny Server

messages.author: ad1a6abcb84542f8
messages.subject: Running cron jobsof R scripts together with Shiny Server
parts:
Hello everyone,

We have a server that has a cron job downloading data every hour from some source through the Internet and into a database (in the same server) using R scripts.
We are developing a Shiny app that uses this data in some way. At some point, there will be around 5 users probably at any given time.
Our intention is to have everything (cron jobs with scripts, database, Shiny Server) in the same server. We want to start using the open source version of Shiny server.

Based on these discussions: 
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/cron$20job/shiny-discuss/uxXsxwkW00s/eG-ICORa-ygJ
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/cron$20job/shiny-discuss/MpnqXKhqnnw/Zk6PNkYBULQJ
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/cron$20job/shiny-discuss/d_KI2gf7ZC0/YUeOyfrTzjEJ

it seem for us that this is actually possible. We are just wondering what happens when the cron job executes: does it create a new rsession? does it "interrupt" the ones that are running Shiny?
The execution itself takes a couple of minutes to retrieve and write all the relevant data.

We just want to be sure that it is compatible to run R scripts in a server while it is running Shiny apps so we do not get surprises when installing Shiny Server.

thanks!

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Running cron jobsof R scripts together with Shiny Server
parts:
Yes, you can.
Just be sure to use a multi-cores CPU server. You can start 4 rsession if you have a 4-cores CPU server. But, to the shiny-server, the 5 person must wait because one shiny-app can start only one session for open source version. 
You may want to have a quick look of this blog: 

http://withr.me/blog/2014/03/19/shiny-server-open-source-edition-solution-for-cpu-bound-apps/
